title: Replay Vision state write activities must use shared retry and timeout constants
answers: What retry policy should Replay Vision Postgres state-write activities use?
How to configure retry and timeout policies for observation media workflow activities?
Where are state activity retry policies defined in Replay Vision Temporal workflows?
body:
Postgres state-transition activities across Replay Vision workflows must use centralized retry and timeout constants.
Where enforced: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY and products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE.
Short state writes (such as observation status updates and thumbnail preparation/finalization) must use STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY (5 attempts with exponential backoff) and STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE (3-minute ceiling).
What breaks if skipped: Shorter ad-hoc retry policies (e.g. 3 attempts in ~3s) permanently drop operations during transient DB connection resets, while unconstrained retry chains can exceed workflow execution timeouts.
applies: Postgres state-write activities in Replay Vision Temporal workflows
